Commentary.Commentary: It has been an interesting Test series and we hope that you all have thoroughly enjoyed it. The 5-match ODI series is coming up, expect New Zealand to come back harder. Join us for the first ODI between India and New Zealand in Dharamshala on 16th of October at 1330 IST. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Sunil Gavaskar gives Virat Kohli the ICC Test championship mace. Virat Kohli feels it's a proud moment for him and to keep this form is the key to remain on top. Adds they are working really hard on the areas where they need improvement. Says they just want to continue this performance.

India captain, Virat Kohli feels that he couldn't have asked for anything better. Adds that the bowlers have put their hands up whenever required in the series and they have bowled really well. (On Pujara and Gambhir) Mentions that it was important for them to be expressive with the bat and their bowlers deserved to be in a comfortable position. (On the series) Feels it has been a proper Test series win and adds that apart from Ashwin (he is not to be mentioned in the eleven), everyone in the eleven played really well. Adds Jadeja with his batting in the first match, Saha in the second and Rohit played crucial knocks. (On Ashwin) Says that we are keen on his numbers, and adds that they keep a track of his man of the series awards after every series.

New Zealand captain, Kane Williamson admits it was going to be tough and credits India for playing so well in this series. Feels they didn't do too well and India outplayed them thoroughly. Credits India and congratulates them for being the number one ranked team. Adds you learn quickly when you face the best bowling attack in this condition. Says they have some positives as a young side and it's unfortunate they couldn't perform as they would have liked to.

Man of the Match and Series, Ravichandran Ashwin thanks the crowd for coming in large numbers. Adds that it was a similar feeling as he used to have as a spectator during the 90's and 2000's. Mentions that he had to work harder in the first innings, needed to be patient on this wicket and the footmarks helped in the final innings. Adds that he wanted the Kiwi batsmen to drive more. Mentions that Mohammed Shami, Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Umesh Yadav bowled well and extracted good reverse swing and Ravindra Jadeja is the perfect foil for him and he enjoys bowling with him. (On his bowling) Says that he is feeling very good about himself and his confidence is sky high at the moment.

India opted not to enforce the follow-on and pressed home the advantage further by setting a mammoth target of 475. Pujara was the star as he scored an unbeaten century. It was always going to be a herculean task for New Zealand to save the match from there and they fell like a pack of cards in the final innings to the guile of Indian bowlers. Ashwin deserves a special mention as he took 13 wickets in the match and 27 in the series.

When the Kiwis came back to bat, their resilient opening pair stitched together a solid 118-run partnership. Once it was broken, the floodgates opened and Ashwin produced a thrilling display of spin bowling grabbing a 6-fer in the process. Guptill, Latham and Neesham batted well to score half centuries but the Kiwis conceded a big lead of 258 runs to the home side.

Earlier in the match, India posted a huge score of 557 on the board in the first innings riding on the skipper's masterclass double ton and Rahane's exceptional 188. The Kiwis tried hard but had no answer to the brilliance of the duo as it was instrumental in pushing the visiting side on the back foot.

India have marched to victory and it has been a thoroughly superlative performance. With that, they whitewash the Black Caps and clinch the series 3-0 and also grab the NUMBER 1 TEST RANKING OFFICIALLY. Ashwin once again came to haunt the Kiwi batsmen in their final innings and they had no answer to his magical spell as he grabbed 7 wickets and ran through their batting order in a jiffy. Jadeja chipped in with a couple of wickets and Yadav with one when New Zealand were asked to chase down 475.
